intentional_semantic_choices: Only value_scheme=normalized_suffix is valid; source suffix and unlocked_tokens variants are deliberately excluded.
The descriptive Python fields serialize canonically as B, g, and m; m counts relaxed mismatches, not arbitrary tokens.
block_size is mandatory so a proposal-width mismatch always fails loudly instead of disabling the guard with None.
SuccessCriteria and all performance, quality, evidence-status, notes, method, runner, metric, and orchestration fields are excluded.
The exact plan gate is used without the source implementation's +1e-9 affordability slack.

A mismatch requires positive budget immediately before that mismatch. This preserves B=0 strictness and makes the remainder strict after an earlier accepted mismatch exactly exhausts B, including within the same block.
RequestRiskState.reset is an engine-neutral reference primitive; stable slot identity, reorder, abort, finish, and device-state cleanup are P03 adapter responsibilities.

The tensor interface accepts compact top_logit/top_token_id/draft_logit tensors only. Candidate alignment, sharded-vocabulary reduction, bonus/cutoff, accept_index, commit length, KV/request state, and native disable-path fixtures are deferred to P03 as required.
explicit_exclusions: keepalive, worker, runbook, ticket, old gates, and experiment orchestration
